== Unverified: 1998 Coruscant Regional, 6th place ==
* '''Claim:''' Matthew Ford says he finished 6th in the "Coruscant Regional" Worlds Qualifier in 1998, at age 14. This was passed on to the wiki editors; no public post by him making the claim has been found yet. If he posted it publicly, cite that post here.
* '''Searched, 13 October 2026, with no corroboration found:'''
** Decipher's 1998 qualifier schedule ([https://web.archive.org/web/19980506111434/http://decipher.com/newsandhighlights/swqualifiers.htm Wayback]). It shows that 1998 "Coruscant" was a region, not a single event. Its qualifiers were New York City (Neutral Ground), Rochester NY and State College PA. The page lists no placings.
** Other Decipher NewsFlash and tournament pages on Wayback. The only Coruscant write-up found is the 1997 Coruscant II Qualifier.
** PC forum compilations [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=11180 t=11180] (no preserved copy yet) and t=8037. t=11180 gives only the top three or four for 1998 Rochester (Hak Soo Kim), NYC (Matt Sokol) and State College (Chris Janiak). Ford is not named, and no 6th place is listed.
** Captured URL lists for DeckTech, Trandosite, Scrye and TheForce.net, plus a web search. No 1998 Coruscant-region standings were found.
* '''To pin it down:''' ask which city (NYC, Rochester or State College) and the date. A full standings list or a tournament report naming him would be enough to add it to the article. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 21:50, 13 October 2026 (UTC)

=== Update: event identified as State College 1998 ===
* Ford's own account (Matthew Ford, personal communication to Bill Bisco via Discord, 13 October 2026): his 1998 regional was the State College, PA Worlds Qualifier, and he placed 6th, aged 14. Chris Janiak won the event and, Ford says, was the only player to beat him that day ("I got absolutely walloped").
* Corroborated: Janiak won the 1998 State College Regional, with Jonathan Chu 2nd and Travis Desell 3rd, per [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=11180 PC forum t=11180] (no preserved copy yet). Ford's 6th place itself is not independently confirmed.
* Searched, 13 October 2026: web search for Janiak or State College 1998 reports, the captured DeckTech, Trandosite and Decipher URL lists, and the wiki. No full standings and no tournament report were found.
* Per Bill (13 October 2026), the result is a plain row in the Tournament Results table, cited to Ford's personal communication and t=11180. If full standings or a report naming him turn up, cite that instead. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 21:58, 13 October 2026 (UTC)
